chapter_seo_title: Lan Nuo's Half-Ancestor Ascension and a Western Reunion
chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen meets aged foe Kailo in the West, learns of Tiger family's mobilization, and arrives to witness Lan Nuo's historic breakthrough to the Half-Ancestor realm.
og_title: Xiao Chen Meets Old Foe Kailo; Lan Nuo Nears Half-Ancestor
og_description: In a Western bar, Xiao Chen reunites with former foe Kailo, now aged and bound to Satan. Meanwhile, Lan Nuo stands on the cusp of Half-Ancestor, drawing allies and enemies alike.
